meta.title: Vendor Grievance and SPOC Management: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as the user without the Vendor role on the specified Growth tenant
Open Vendor Grievance and SPOC Management and determine whether the non-Vendor user is refused or the feature is absent
Repeat the action as a Vendor and determine whether the feature is available
Verify the tenant's Growth plan and record any deliberate RBAC configuration that grants access to other roles
